comments.name: GlobalCitizen_Leo
comments.content: Seeing SpaceX Q3 AI business explode by 830% and Musk talking about 1 trillion ARR next year is truly insane, a real testament to innovation. But then you look at Anthropic's whopping $807B net loss in H1, despite Q2 turning profitable on an adjusted basis. It highlights the crazy high-stakes game in AI; massive growth potential but also huge burn rates. CoreWeave's credit crisis sounding like SVB, not 2008 subprime, is a critical distinction. It implies liquidity issues, not systemic solvency risk, but still, definitely something to monitor closely across the tech sector. This whole market is so volatile, it makes you wonder about the sustainability and valuation bubbles. Gotta stay diversified, you know?
